title: Northgate Same-Day Delivery Express Promise and the Late-Express Credit
content:
**Entitlement.** A Northgate Same-Day Delivery express order of **Northgate Store and Online Orders** promises delivery within the express window on its order date, so an express order whose express delivery fee was charged above zero and whose fulfilled date is a later calendar day than its order date missed that promise and is owed a late-express credit, booked as one refund of the order's express delivery fee with reason fee refund.

**Fee refunds on such an order.** For the express delivery fee of a Same-Day Delivery order fulfilled on a later calendar day than its order date, and only for that fee, the late-express credit is refunded as this rule states, whatever tender paid the order; for every other fee on that order and for every fee on any other order, a fee is refunded only as stated in the returns rule and the fulfilment and cancellation rule, or in the rule written for that charge.

**Tender.** The amount of the credit is the same whatever tender paid the order. It is booked at the care desk only on an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it. On every other order the same amount applies; its posting to the Northgate Card, Northgate Cash or gift card ledger is made by a human representative to whom the customer is handed over with the reason policy not covered, and nothing is booked at the care desk.

**Invocation — `credit_late_express_4845a2c0`.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. It books one refund of part or all of the order's express delivery fee, credited to the external payment card that paid the order and recorded against that express fee with the reason fee refund; the net amount paid on the order goes down by the credit, and the customer sees the credit on the order and on the card at once. An order not paid in full by an external card, or with Northgate Cash or a gift card redeemed on it, is refused and nothing is recorded.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the reference number of the Same-Day Delivery order, read from the customer's order lookup | identifier |
| `fee_event_id` | the reference number of the express delivery fee charged on that order, read from the order's line and fee lookup | identifier |
| `credit_amount_usd` | the credit refunded on the express delivery fee | US dollars, a positive number with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text starting with "Credited" means the credit is booked and gives `refund_event_id`, `order_id`, `fee_event_id`, `credit_amount_usd` and `amount_paid_usd` (the order's net amount paid after the credit), amounts with 2 decimals. A text starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: an amount not above zero or with more than 2 decimal places, an order that does not exist, a reference that is not an express delivery fee charged on that order, or an order refused on its tender.
